prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: landscape game cover artwork, 1200 x 630 pixels
Primary request: Create polished key art for bBall, a fast minimal neon paddle-and-ball duel. This is a Pong-like arcade game, NOT basketball.
Scene/backdrop: almost-black navy #06080f, subtle perspective court lattice, restrained luminous atmosphere.
Subject: one upright aqua #4ff0d6 paddle on the left and one upright rose #ff5c8a paddle on the right, a single bright pearl-white ball streaking diagonally between them with a graceful aqua motion trail and a few tiny collision sparks. Paddles are simple slim rounded bars, no handles. Bold readable silhouette, premium minimal arcade aesthetic.
Composition: landscape 1200x630, action occupies right two thirds; left third is dark negative space with a crisp large wordmark reading exactly "bBall", lowercase b in aqua and "Ball" in near-white, bold geometric sans-serif. Small subtitle below exactly "BOUNCE. BATTLE. REPEAT." Keep title and key action inset from edges.
Lighting/mood: electric, competitive, precise, elegant, luminous restrained bloom, dark negative space.
Avoid: basketballs, basketball hoops, sports players, characters, controllers, extra balls, illegible microtext, interface buttons, excessive particles, photoreal textures, mockup frames, watermarks.
